purpose: LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL, an anti-join written as an outer join
sql:
SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name
FROM part p
LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1998-11-01'
WHERE l.l_orderkey IS NULL
  AND p.p_size = 1

extra.AI Reason: The query uses a LEFT JOIN with an IS NULL filter to perform an anti-join, and a Hash Join is efficient for joining the filtered part and lineitem tables.
Sequential scan is chosen for the part table as there is no index on p_size.
Hash node to build the hash table for the anti-join.
Sequential scan on lineitem to filter by shipdate.

Join of (lineitem, part): PostgreSQL performs a Right join, the AI an Anti join.
Hash Join of (lineitem) with (part): PostgreSQL applies l_orderkey is null here, the AI does not.
Hash: PostgreSQL applies it to (part), the AI to (lineitem).
Only the PostgreSQL plan has Gather over (lineitem, part) (collects rows from parallel worker processes).
